name: Bootstrap select picker
description: Field widget that renders option/entity-reference fields with the third-party bootstrap-select jQuery dropdown.
library_dependencies: bootstrap-select 1.13.18 (external, snapappointments/bootstrap-select; loaded via jsDelivr CDN or /libraries/bootstrap-select)
project_description:
3rd party js selectpicker bootstrap-select form widget for Bootstrap themed sites. The bootstrap-select library is loaded by default via the jsDelivr CDN, but the module checks for a local copy at web/libraries/bootstrap-select and uses that instead when present.

The module ships a single field widget (bootstrap_select_widget) suitable for most option fields: list_integer, list_float, list_string and entity_reference. It exposes the widget's common options through the Manage form display UI: Live search, Actions box (Select All / Deselect All), Placeholder, Header, and Selected text format (value vs count with a count template). It has no menu, no permissions and no site-wide settings; configuration is per-field on the form-display. Depends on Bootstrap v4 being present in the active theme.
